receipt: Revenue = bill(M).adjusted; donations excluded; receipt and provider view share M
cost_state: Raw draft strings are validated into empty/invalid/valid states with the same contract in UI, engine and link parser. Valid zero is explicit zero; empty and invalid never become supplied zero. Numeric slots and legacy Known flags are derived from drafts. All four must be valid and costsReviewed=1 with costBasis matching M before a balance. Editing costs invalidates review; changing M makes it stale. Clearing costs preserves receipt and unrelated assumptions.
rounding: Keep percentage precision until final USD charge; exact decimal multiplication and half-away-from-zero cent rounding. Serving/development/operations allocations accept at most two decimals. The 0–20% fee range is a calculator bound, not a claim about processors.

formulas.monthly_balance: settled bill - servingCost - developmentCost - operationsCost - roundToCents(settled bill * paymentFee / 100)
formulas.expected_12_month_balance: monthly balance * sum((1 - leavingRate / 100)^t, t = 0..11) - additional customerAcquisition
formulas.loyalty: Discount min(monthlyBenefit, settled bill); recalculate payment fees; departures = leavingRate * (1 - retentionGain / 100); other allocations remain fixed per retained customer

limits: No OpenAI cost estimate or margin inference. User allocations must count each expense once. Optional worksheet is before financing, taxes and omitted expenses. Foundation donations have a separate charitable destination and are excluded. It is not company profit, cash flow, break-even or contribution-margin accounting. Fixed/shared expenses need not vanish when a customer leaves. Negative reviewed results are visible. Original source corpus is unchanged.

public_benchmark.sourceLocations: Results of Operations, p. 150; Note 8, Supplemental Operating Expense Information, p. F-40
public_benchmark.limitations: Company-wide accounting ratios, not a subscriber bill or profit per token. Free-user compute and channel-partner costs are included in sales and marketing. No Anthropic percentage is applied to OpenAI or loaded into the simulator.

classification_guide: Reported figures: the cited filing. Calculated figures: per-$100 ratios. Assumed figures: all provider simulator cost and retention inputs. No peer percentage fills a simulation input.
